issues.description: The portability patch reuses the byte-identical GNU config triplet fix already merged for libICE instead of being emitted by refresh-patch after init-build selected the wrong project root.
issues.fix_suggestion: No candidate code change is required. The pure unified diff was bound by SHA-256, applied by Git and patch, and exercised by both target package variants; improve project-root selection separately from this recipe PR.

summary: W4 audit of libsm 1.2.6 at audit input SHA-256 dd2918a3686afe5f63aacc394f27b47f96dce814c640c1b576eb0469cabe4679. PASS with P0=0 and P1=0. The 14-file input was confined to archives/l/libsm, contained no binaries or forbidden state files, used the official X.Org source and verified SHA-256, declared the exact libICE/xorgproto/xtrans graph, and contained no OHOS conditional-compilation macro. Both consumers call real libSM APIs and were executed on HarmonyOS/AArch64 for shared and static packages. W3 r6 independently validated upstream 0/0 and adapted 2/2, including AArch64 ELF, SONAME, NEEDED, headers, pkg-config metadata, symbols, static members, input immutability, and released device lock. The only finding is the non-blocking patch-generation provenance note above.
